records.jp: ……うんうん、それで？　その続きも聞かせて！
records.en_original: ...Uh-huh, uh-huh, and then? Tell me more!
records.en_auxiliary: ...Uh-huh, uh-huh, and then? Tell me more!
records.en: ...Uh-huh, uh-huh, and then? Tell me more!

records.jp: 続きをと言われてもな……。<CR>それ以上のことはあまり意識していない
records.en_original: I would, but there's no more to tell.
records.en_auxiliary: I would, but there's no more to tell.
records.en: I would, but there's no more to tell.

records.jp: 亜子……もしかして、有理に取材してるところ？
records.en_original: Ako, are you...interviewing Yuri?
records.en_auxiliary: Ako, are you... interviewing Yuri?
records.en: Ako, are you...interviewing Yuri?

records.jp: あ、白井ちゃん！<CR>白井ちゃんも色々気になってるよね！
records.en_original: Heya, Shirai! You've gotta be curious too, right!?
records.en_auxiliary: Heya, Shirai! You've gotta be curious too, right?!
records.en: Heya, Shirai-chan! You've gotta be curious too, right!?

records.jp: 色々って……例えば？
records.en_original: Curious...? About what?
records.en_auxiliary: Curious? About what?
records.en: Curious...? About what?

records.jp: 美の秘訣だよ！　だってこんなにスタイルいいんだよ？<CR>その秘訣とか、気になるでしょー
records.en_original: About her beauty secrets! Look how stylish she is! Aren't you curious about her tricks?
records.en_auxiliary: About her beauty secrets! Look how stylish she is! Aren't you curious about her tricks?
records.en: About her beauty secrets! Look how stylish she is! Aren't you curious about her tricks?

records.jp: あはは……研究の内容とかじゃなくて、<CR>スタイルの話だったんだ……
records.en_original: Ahaha... So you were talking about her style, not her research...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha... So you were talking about her style and not her research.
records.en: Ahaha... So you were talking about her style, not her research...

records.jp: もちろん研究してることも気になるけど、<CR>やっぱり記事になるのはスタイルの方かなって！
records.en_original: Of course I'm curious about her research, but her style would make for a better article!
records.en_auxiliary: Of course, I'm curious about her research, but her style would make for a better article!
records.en: Of course I'm curious about her research, but her style would make for a better article!

records.jp: なるほど……確かに、気になってる人は多いかもね
records.en_original: Huh... You're probably right, though. I'm sure a lot of people want to know.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh... You're probably right. I'm sure a lot of people want to know.
records.en: Huh... You're probably right, though. I'm sure a lot of people want to know.

records.jp: そう言われても、何もしていないから困る……。<CR>あえて言うなら食事を必要最低限にしているくらいか
records.en_original: You say that, but I'm not doing anything... The only possible explanation is that I eat the bare minimum.
records.en_auxiliary: You say that, but I'm not doing anything. The only possible explanation is that I eat the bare minimum.
records.en: You say that, but I'm not doing anything... The only possible explanation is that I eat the bare minimum.

records.jp: 有理の場合は、最低限を下回ってると思うよ……
records.en_original: In your case, I think it's below the bare minimum...
records.en_auxiliary: In your case, I think it's below the bare minimum.
records.en: In your case, I think it's below the bare minimum...

records.jp: そうか？　しかし、このとおり生命を維持できている。<CR>何ら問題はないはずだ
records.en_original: Do you? But as you can see, I continue to live. Ergo, I do not eat below the bare minimum.
records.en_auxiliary: Do you? But as you can see, I continue to live. Ergo, I do not eat below the bare minimum.
records.en: Do you? But as you can see, I continue to live. Ergo, I do not eat below the bare minimum.

records.jp: 今は良くても、将来困るんじゃないかな……
records.en_original: Sure, you're fine now, but you might have trouble later...
records.en_auxiliary: Sure, you're fine now, but you might have trouble later.
records.en: Sure, you're fine now, but you might have trouble later...

records.jp: それより、私は取材をする心理を問いたかったのだが、<CR>なぜこんなことに……
records.en_original: That's beside the point. I wanted to ask about the mentality behind your interviews. How did it turn out like this...?
records.en_auxiliary: That's beside the point. I wanted to ask about the mentality behind your interviews. How did it turn out like this?
records.en: That's beside the point. I wanted to ask about the mentality behind your interviews. How did it turn out like this...?

records.jp: 今まさに取材中！<CR>だから、ありのままの心理が見られるでしょ？
records.en_original: Hey, we're in an interview now, right!? You should be able to see the mentality behind it firsthand!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, we're in an interview now, right?! You should be able to see the mentality behind it firsthand!
records.en: Hey, we're in an interview now, right!? You should be able to see the mentality behind it firsthand!

records.jp: ……取材される側にいるのでは、矢継ぎ早に質問が来て<CR>相手の心理を考察する暇がないのだが
records.en_original: ...But you're interviewing me, and your questions come so quickly that I don't have a chance to analyze you.
records.en_auxiliary: But you're interviewing me, and your questions come so quickly that I don't have a chance to analyze you.
records.en: ...But you're interviewing me, and your questions come so quickly that I don't have a chance to analyze you.

records.jp: それもそっかあ……じゃあ、白井ちゃんから見てどう？<CR>取材する人の心理って、どういう風に見える？
records.en_original: I guess that's true... What do you think, Shirai? What kind of mentality does an interviewer have?
records.en_auxiliary: I guess that's true. What do you think, Shirai? What kind of mentality does an interviewer have?
records.en: I guess that's true... What do you think, Shirai-chan? What kind of mentality does an interviewer have?

records.jp: 亜子……さては自分で答えるのが面倒なんでしょ
records.en_original: Ako... You just don't want to go through the trouble of explaining yourself, do you?
records.en_auxiliary: Ako... You just don't want to go through the trouble of explaining yourself, do you?
records.en: Ako... You just don't want to go through the trouble of explaining yourself, do you?

records.jp: ふっふっふー。どうかなー？
records.en_original: Hehehe. You tell me!
records.en_auxiliary: Hehehe. You tell me!
records.en: Hehehe. You tell me!

records.jp: それは……
records.en_original: Okay then...
records.en_auxiliary: Okay then...
records.en: Okay then...

records.jp: 真実を明らかにしたい……ってところじゃない？<CR>亜子、前に社会の矛盾を暴くとか言ってたし
records.en_original: Isn't it... A desire to uncover the truth? Ako, you said before that you want to "expose society's contradictions."
records.en_auxiliary: Doesn't it involve a desire to uncover the truth? Ako, you said before that you want to "expose society's contradictions."
records.en: Isn't it... A desire to uncover the truth? Ako, you said before that you want to "expose society's contradictions."

records.jp: 真実を明らかに……なるほど、研究と同じなのか
records.en_original: A desire to uncover the truth... Then an interviewer is just like a researcher.
records.en_auxiliary: A desire to uncover the truth... Then an interviewer is just like a researcher.
records.en: A desire to uncover the truth... Then an interviewer is just like a researcher.

records.jp: そうそう、まさにそうなんだよー！
records.en_original: Yeah, that's exactly right!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, that's exactly right!
records.en: Yeah, that's exactly right!

records.jp: もう。調子いいんだから……
records.en_original: Then maybe you should've said that yourself...
records.en_auxiliary: Then maybe you should've said that yourself.
records.en: Then maybe you should've said that yourself...

records.jp: 真実を追い求めて質疑を投げかけ、<CR>時には実地に赴いて調査する……
records.en_original: Pursuing the truth, raising new questions, and at times, conducting actual investigations...
records.en_auxiliary: Pursuing the truth, raising new questions, and at times, conducting actual investigations.
records.en: Pursuing the truth, raising new questions, and at times, conducting actual investigations...

records.jp: そしてその結果を新聞やネットニュースとして<CR>広く周知するわけか
records.en_original: And in the end, the results are spread far and wide through newspapers and internet news sites...
records.en_auxiliary: And in the end, the results are spread far and wide through newspapers and internet news sites.
records.en: And in the end, the results are spread far and wide through newspapers and internet news sites...

records.jp: うん、行き過ぎることもたまにあるけどね……。<CR>今の亜子みたいに、相手を困らせちゃったり
records.en_original: Yeah, though sometimes it can go too far... Like how Ako is causing trouble for you right now.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, though sometimes it can go too far. Like how Ako is causing trouble for you right now.
records.en: Yeah, though sometimes it can go too far... Like how Ako is causing trouble for you right now.

records.jp: そ、そこは反省してるよー……。<CR>ごめんね、斎木ちゃん
records.en_original: Y-Yeah, I realize that... Sorry, Saiki.
records.en_auxiliary: Y-yeah, I realize that. Sorry, Saiki.
records.en: Y-Yeah, I realize that... Sorry, Saiki-chan.

records.jp: いや……真実を追い求めるがゆえだろう。<CR>その気持ちはよくわかる
records.en_original: No need... It's all in the name of pursuing the truth. I completely understand that feeling.
records.en_auxiliary: No need. It's all in the name of pursuing the truth. I completely understand that feeling.
records.en: No need... It's all in the name of pursuing the truth. I completely understand that feeling.

records.jp: 斎木ちゃん……じゃあ、もっと色々お話を……！<CR>全ては真実を明らかにするために！
records.en_original: In that case, Saiki... Let's talk about more things...! For the sake of uncovering the truth!
records.en_auxiliary: In that case, Saiki... Let's talk about more things! For the sake of uncovering the truth!
records.en: In that case, Saiki-chan... Let's talk about more things...! For the sake of uncovering the truth!

records.jp: い、いや、私は用があるのでこれで……
records.en_original: N-no, I'm afraid I have things to do, so I'll be going now...
records.en_auxiliary: N-no, I'm afraid I have things to do, so I'll be going now.
records.en: N-no, I'm afraid I have things to do, so I'll be going now...

records.jp: （全然反省してない……）
records.en_original: (She isn't sorry at all...)
records.en_auxiliary: (She isn't sorry at all.)
records.en: (She isn't sorry at all...)

records.jp: ……お金を稼ぐためじゃない？<CR>なんだかんだでスクープってお金になるイメージあるし
records.en_original: ...Isn't it to make money? I have this image in my mind of big scoops making big money.
records.en_auxiliary: Isn't it to make money? I have this image in my mind of big scoops making big money.
records.en: ...Isn't it to make money? I have this image in my mind of big scoops making big money.

records.jp: あはは、確かにそれもあるかも！<CR>お金ないと食べていけないもんねー
records.en_original: Ahaha, yeah, that's kinda true! A girl's gotta put food on the table, after all!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, yeah, that's kinda true! A girl's gotta put food on the table, after all!
records.en: Ahaha, yeah, that's kinda true! A girl's gotta put food on the table, after all!

records.jp: ふむ……金銭を求めて、か。<CR>私には縁のない感情だな……
records.en_original: Hm... The pursuit of money? That's a feeling that I can't relate to...
records.en_auxiliary: Hm. The pursuit of money? That's a feeling that I can't relate to.
records.en: Hm... The pursuit of money? That's a feeling that I can't relate to...

records.jp: えっ、斎木ちゃん、お金は大事だよ！
records.en_original: But Saiki, money's important!
records.en_auxiliary: But Saiki, money's important!
records.en: But Saiki-chan, money's important!

records.jp: 現時点で、暮らすのに不足はないからな。<CR>研究にかかる費用も今のところ問題ない
records.en_original: At present, I want for nothing. There aren't even any issues with my research funds.
records.en_auxiliary: At present, I want for nothing. There aren't even any issues with my research funds.
records.en: At present, I want for nothing. There aren't even any issues with my research funds.

records.jp: 必要以上のものは求めてないってことかな……？
records.en_original: So you don't want anything more than your needs...?
records.en_auxiliary: So you don't want anything more than your needs met?
records.en: So you don't want anything more than your needs...?

records.jp: まあ、そんなところだ
records.en_original: I suppose you could put it that way.
records.en_auxiliary: I suppose you could put it that way.
records.en: I suppose you could put it that way.

records.jp: さて……取材する側の心理も<CR>それなりにわかったことだし、そろそろ失礼するよ
records.en_original: Anyway... Now that I have an understanding of the mentality behind interviews, I should get going.
records.en_auxiliary: Anyway, now that I have an understanding of the mentality behind interviews, I should get going.
records.en: Anyway... Now that I have an understanding of the mentality behind interviews, I should get going.

records.jp: あ、斎木ちゃん、まだまだ聞きたいことが……！
records.en_original: Wait, Saiki, I wanted to ask you more...!
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, Saiki, I wanted to ask you more!
records.en: Wait, Saiki-chan, I wanted to ask you more...!

records.jp: そ、それは、またの機会にしてくれ……<CR>取材される側の心理も十分わかったから、しばらくは……
records.en_original: P-Please, save it for another time... I've more than enough understanding of the mentality behind an interview...
records.en_auxiliary: P-please, save it for another time. I've more than enough understanding of the mentality behind an interview.
records.en: P-Please, save it for another time... I've more than enough understanding of the mentality behind an interview...

records.jp: あはは……さすがにちょっと疲れ気味……かな？
records.en_original: Ahaha... An interview with Ako would wipe me out, too...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha... An interview with Ako would wipe me out, too.
records.en: Ahaha... An interview with Ako would wipe me out, too...
